timothy2.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,

timothy2.1.p1.b3.text: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

timothy2.1.p2.b1.text: … as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.

timothy2.1.p2.b2.text: Recalling your tears, I long to see you …

timothy2.1.p2.b3.text: … your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.

timothy2.1.p3.b1.text: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

timothy2.1.p3.b2.text: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

timothy2.1.p3.b3.text: So do not be ashamed … of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.

timothy2.1.p4.b1.text: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace …

timothy2.1.p4.b2.text: … who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel

timothy2.1.p4.b3.text: to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.

timothy2.1.p4.b4.text: … I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day.

timothy2.1.p5.b1.text: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

timothy2.1.p5.b2.text: Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

timothy2.1.p6.b1.text: You know that everyone in the Province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

timothy2.1.p6.b2.text: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains. Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.

timothy2.1.p6.b3.text: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
